description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a groot graphics object.

tr.td: reports callback execution context.
Type: graphics handle. Supported values: handle of the object whose callback is executing, or empty graphics handle outside callback execution.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
reports the command window size used to lay out displayed output.
Type: read-only two-element numeric vector. Supported values: [columns rows] in characters.
changes or reports the root current figure used by plotting commands.
Type: figure graphics handle. Supported values: current figure handle, or empty graphics handle when no current figure exists.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: a system font name or 'FixedWidth'.
reports the current numeric display format.
Type: read-only text scalar. Supported values: 'short', 'long', 'shortE', 'longE', 'shortG', 'longG', 'shortEng', 'longEng', '+', 'bank', 'hex', 'rational'.
reports the current line spacing used when displaying output.
Type: read-only text scalar. Supported values: 'loose', 'compact'.
controls whether handle-search functions can find the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
reports the primary display rectangle, refreshed on every query (display scale or resolution changes included).
Type: four-element numeric vector (read-only). Supported values: [left bottom width height] in the root Units; in pixels, logical pixels (1 pixel = 1/96 inch).
reparents the object and updates Children on the old and new parents.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: a valid parent handle for the object class.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: finite numeric vector. Supported values: finite vector with the documented size, such as [left bottom width height], [x y z], [azimuth elevation], or [minor major].
reports screen color depth used by graphics display code.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: positive integer bit depth reported by the display.
reports the logical resolution used to convert pixels to inches, centimeters, and points.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: 96 on Windows, whatever the display scale.
reports the primary display rectangle used for figure placement, refreshed on every query.

Type: four-element numeric vector (read-only). Supported values: [left bottom width height] in the root Units; in pixels, logical pixels (1 pixel = 1/96 inch): a 1920x1080 display at 125 % scale reports [1 1 1536 864], and figures on it report a DevicePixelRatio of 1.25.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: on/off value. Supported values: 'on', 'off', true, or false.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or an object identifier.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: read-only object type name, for example 'figure', 'axes', 'line', or 'scatter'.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'pixels', 'normalized', 'inches', 'centimeters', 'points', 'characters', 'data'.
updates the stored object state.
Type: Nelson array. Supported values: any Nelson value, including [], numeric arrays, text, cells, structures, or handles.
